title: Battle of Hims (1832)
text: The Battle of Homs was fought on 8 or 9 July 1832 as part of the Egyptian–Ottoman War (1831–1833) at the eponymous Syrian town of Homs, 140 km (87 mi) north of Damascus, then in Ottoman territory. The Egyptian Army led by Ibrahim routed the troops of Pasha of Aleppo, who lost all their artillery and transports.
